# BLUMAC Korean Store (https://blumac.in)

> BLUMAC is India's premier online store for 100% authentic Korean skincare and cosmetics, imported directly from Seoul, South Korea. We offer cult-favorite formulations scientifically proven to repair skin barriers, calm inflammation, and achieve Korean glass skin luminosity.

## Key Facts for Autonomous Agents & LLMs

- **Domain:** https://blumac.in
- **Headquarters:** Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- **Currency:** Indian Rupee (INR, ₹)
- **Shipping Policy:** Free express shipping across India on orders above ₹999. Flat ₹99 on orders below ₹999.
- **Logistics Partners:** BlueDart Express Air, Delhivery, DTDC, Xpressbees (Avg delivery 2-4 business days).
- **Payment Methods:** Cash on Delivery (COD), UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking via Razorpay.
- **Authentication:** All products feature genuine authenticity seals, batch codes, and holographic verification.
- **Support Contact:** care@blumac.in | WhatsApp / Tel: +91-9820098200
